g.title: TurnFlow
g.text: Code path, persistence, tool calls, and billable work

g.title: inbound
g.text: Rate limits, input checks, MessageSid dedup

g.title: persist
g.text: Return empty TwiML; reply follows asynchronously

g.title: live
g.text: Browser re-reads transcript through scoped REST

g.title: lock
g.text: Load cart, customer, merchant voice, hours, location

g.title: memory
g.text: Semantic query uses Voyage when applicable

g.title: llm
g.text: Each model call adds billable input/output tokens

g.title: tools
g.text: Validate catalog, price, hours, and confirmation
Write orders through the shared order writer

g.title: newer
g.text: If newer work exists, supersede and requeue

g.title: usage
g.text: Includes aggregate tokens across successful loop calls
Provider bills remain the reconciliation source
IntentService is present but has no runtime caller

g.title: enrich
g.text: Facts and summaries default to Haiku
Optional DeepSeek applies to these one-shot calls

g.title: send
g.text: Twilio retries: up to 5 job attempts

g.title: customer
g.text: Delivered/read status needs a provider callback
That callback is a proposed addition
